author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Orange Pi has published hardware details for the OrangePi O1, a 90 × 70mm SBC based on the Sophgo BM1688 processor. It pairs eight Arm Cortex-A53 cores with a RISC-V C906 coprocessor and a 16-TOPS INT8 TPU, along with up to 16GB of LPDDR4/LPDDR4X memory. title: 16-TOPS AI SBC with SATA 3.0 runs on octa-core Sophgo BM1688
